title: Catalog
description: What Booth Engineer sends about a music library: track metadata only. Never audio, never file paths.

history_since.description: Since when Radio Booth has watched this library for new tracks: the first catalog Booth Engineer read after it started keeping track. Tracks already there have no joined dates.

id.description: Opaque id, unique within this catalog. Booth Engineer maps it back to the file locally.

artists.description: Every credited artist, when a tag lists several. artist stays the name as shown.

original_year.description: When the music first came out, when it differs from year (the release the listener has, e.g. a reissue).

added_at.description: No longer sent (Booth Engineer 0.5.8 on) and ignored by Booth DJ: a music server's add date is when it first scanned a track, not when the listener got it. joined_after and joined_by take its place.

play_count.description: No longer sent (Booth Engineer 0.5.8 on) and ignored by Booth DJ: a music server's play count misses every other player the listener uses.

last_played_at.description: No longer sent (Booth Engineer 0.5.8 on): a music server's last play misses every other player the listener uses.

last_in_show_at.description: When this track was last in a Radio Booth show delivered to this machine for this person, from Booth Engineer's local history. Lets new shows skip recent picks.

in_shows.description: How many of this person's Radio Booth shows had this track, from Booth Engineer's local history.

in_shows_at_least.description: True when in_shows includes history kept before shows were counted, so the real number may be higher.

recent_shows.description: This person's latest Radio Booth shows that had this track, newest first.

joined_after.description: The track first turned up in this library after this day (the catalog read before it), as Booth Engineer saw it. Only for tracks that arrived after history_since.

joined_by.description: ... and by this day (the catalog read that first had it).

from_path.description: True when title, artist or album came from folder and file names, not tags.

sonic.description: Sonic analysis if the music server has it. Shape depends on the provider.
